journey.name: spark transfer to spending
journey.description:
Verifies that Spark is the easy option where Transfer To Spending otherwise leads to Manual Setup. With Spark ready, Funding leads with "Transfer from Savings" (testTag "FundTransfer") and "Use Other Wallet" (testTag "FundReceive") above "Manual Setup" (testTag "FundManual"), and the Savings and Spending transfer buttons open the Spark amount screen (testTag "SpendingAmount") instead of the Transfer Unavailable sheet. The confirm screen shows the network fee and the Spark claim fee. The early-claim offer on the deposit screen needs a real deposit Spark sees, so this journey stops before the swipe.
Precondition: dev build with Spark connected on its regtest (no key needed), onboarded wallet with a positive on-chain Savings balance and no channels. Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Tap the Savings balance card (testTag "ActivitySavings"), tap "Transfer To Spending" (testTag "TransferToSpending") and verify the amount screen (testTag "SpendingAmount") opens with the available amount, not the Transfer Unavailable sheet

Tap "Max" (testTag "SpendingAmountMax"), tap "Continue" (testTag "SpendingAmountContinue") and verify the confirm screen shows "Network fees", "Claim fee", "To spending" and "Total", and a swipe to transfer
Go back to the wallet home, open Settings › Advanced › Lightning Connections and tap add connection (testTag "add_connection_button")

Verify "Transfer from Savings" (testTag "FundTransfer") and "Use Other Wallet" (testTag "FundReceive") are enabled above "Manual Setup" (testTag "FundManual"), and "Transfer from HW wallet" (testTag "FundHardware") is disabled
Tap "Transfer from Savings" and verify the amount screen (testTag "SpendingAmount") opens
